description: This PHP source file defines the `VacancyListRSSController` class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. The class generates an RSS feed of published job vacancies, including RSS-specific XML structure and metadata. It handles HTTP responses to serve the RSS XML, and interfaces with underlying services for localization, configuration, URL generation, and vacancy data retrieval.

classes.name: VacancyListRSSController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating an RSS feed of active vacancy listings. Implements methods to handle HTTP responses, generate RSS XML, and retrieve published vacancy data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request by setting RSS headers and returning an XML response containing the vacancy RSS feed.

methods.name: generateRSSFeed
methods.description: Generates the RSS XML document with site info and list of published vacancy items formatted as RSS items.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of published vacancies from the underlying vacancy data access object.
